reader.requirement: An explicitly referenced paragraph-name must not be duplicated within its section; a paragraph is qualified by its section-name without the word SECTION; an unqualified paragraph-name resolves within the referencing section; no program may reference another program's paragraph or section.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Cite: only the message text of COBOL2121/COBOL2122; the refusal is the same code

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, Edition.Year, EditionContext, CobolVersion, Permissive and ConstructRegistry in NameResolution.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.Procedures.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, QualifiedNameClasses.cs, OccursKeyResolvePass.cs, OdoResolvePass.cs, StatementValidation.cs, DataBinder.cs#UniqueOrReportAmbiguous; the grammar rules qualification, dataReference, procedureName and reportGroupReference carry no version predicate; ProcedureNamed consults no edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: duplicate procedure names and qualification; SECTION after the qualifier, an unreferenced in-section duplicate and a nested program's reference are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0: S1-P1 / S2-P1 x3 / S1-P2 / S1-P1 / S1-P2 / LC 03 02 / END
probes.expected: P1 OF S1, P1 IN S2, unqualified P1 from within S2, PERFORM P1 OF S1 THRU P2 IN S1, GO TO FIN OF S9, LINAGE-COUNTER OF/IN file all resolve
a paragraph duplicated within a section but never explicitly referenced is legal

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL2121 PERFORM 'P1': the reference is not unique ... 2 times (S1, S2)
probes.expected: unqualified P1 from a third section is ambiguous (SRL2.1/SRL2.6)
When a paragraph-name is qualified by a section-name, the word SECTION must not appear

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL2122 PERFORM 'P1': that paragraph-name is declared 2 times within section 'S1' ... (1985 IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.6)
probes.expected: an explicitly referenced paragraph-name duplicated within a section is refused

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL1639 PERFORM 'OUTER-OTHER' names no procedure ... may not be referenced from any other program
probes.expected: a nested program cannot reference its container's paragraph

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.6  the text is in SRL2.6 (quoted: a paragraph-name must not be duplicated within a section)

reader.notes: ProcedureNamed resolves the containing section first, then the whole source element; duplicates are kept and refused only at a reference (COBOL2122 in-section, COBOL2121 across sections), so an unreferenced duplicate compiles. The grammar has no SECTION after the qualifier, and procedure-names are per source element, so a nested program's reference to its container's paragraph is refused.

refuter.evidence: pn1.cob: PERFORM P1 OF S1 and ALTER TO PROCEED TO P1 OF S1 with P1 twice in S1 -> COBOL2122; P1 OF S2 and GO TO P2 OF S1 naming a paragraph not in that section -> COBOL1639. pn2.cob: duplicate paragraphs with no sections -> COBOL2121. pn3.cob: USE FOR DEBUGGING ON P1 and GO TO P9 DEPENDING across sections -> COBOL2121. pn4.cob: P1 IN S1 THRU P2 OF S1 and ALTER X1 OF S3 TO PROCEED TO P2 IN S1 run correctly (S1-P1 S1-P2 S2-P1 S1-P2 S2-P1 S2-P9). sib.cob: a sibling program's paragraph PA -> COBOL1639. cite: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.6  the text is in SRL2.6.
